title: Add a walled obstacle corridor to the hexapod terrain generator
summary: The terrain v2.2 generator can add an opt-in seventh tile type: a walled corridor of static boxes and pillars, with an open lane at least as wide as the gap. That gap shrinks from 0.90 m to 0.62 m with difficulty. The default v2.2 course is unchanged, and the standalone Isaac Sim obstacle-course script with its movable crates, balls, Jetbot and keyboard drive is removed. The policy is blind, so the corridor tests recovery from walking into walls, not navigation.
next: Load make_hexapod_terrains_cfg(obstacle_corridor=True) in Hexapod-Rough-v22-Direct-v0 natively on the Spark and check the corridor tiles render and reset on level ground.
reason: An opt-in terrain type for the original hexapod task; the default course, admitted model, gates, roadmap marker and omniwalk runtime are unchanged, and no native result is recorded.
